task.goal: How many tasks do I have due next week in Tasks app? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single integer.
task.final_summary: You have 6 tasks due next week. The week runs Monday Oct 16 through Sunday Oct 22, 2023, and I counted only incomplete tasks: Complete project proposal (Mon Oct 16, shown as "Tmrw"), Review code changes (Tue Oct 17), Organize files and folders (Wed Oct 18), Organize movie night (Fri Oct 20), Prepare agenda for weekly meeting (Sat Oct 21) and Plan family reunion (Sun Oct 22). The other weekday-labelled tasks (Meal Prep for the Week, Renew Driver's License, Submit Expense Report, Grocery Shopping, Learn to Play Guitar) turned out to fall in the past week, Oct 9 to Oct 11, which I confirmed in each task's date picker.
